description: A peak-reading level meter for up to sixteen channels, with an X/Y plot of the first two

params.text: X/Y shows the first two channels as two meters beside a plot of one against the other; MULTI shows a row of meters instead
Sets how many meters the row shows: 4CH, 8CH or 16CH

inputs.text: Added to the first channel of MULTI IN, shown on meter 1 and used as the horizontal axis of the X/Y plot
Added to the second channel of MULTI IN, shown on meter 2 and used as the vertical axis of the X/Y plot
A polyphonic input whose channels feed meters 1 to 16 in order, the first two of them summed with IN L and IN R

notes: 0dB on the meters is 10V peak, a 20V peak-to-peak signal, and every channel is clipped there before it is measured
each channel goes through a two-pole highpass filter at 10Hz before the meter, so direct current does not lift the reading on a small signal
a meter above the number of channels MULTI IN carries reads silence rather than holding its last value
sixteen per-channel reference levels are stored in the patch, but nothing changes them: the scroll handler that once set them is commented out in the source, so they stay at 0dB
